Shenzhen Kingyield Technology Co., Ltd.
is an original brand manufacturer (OBM) and designer that primarily develops and sells its
own branded medical and home healthcare devices
rather than acting as a major distributor for other third-party electronics or external manufacturer brands.
Core Products Manufactured by Kingyield
The company designs, manufactures, and markets products under its own name and for OEM/ODM clients, spanning categories such as:
Blood pressure monitors
(including digital upper arm monitors and blood pressure watches)
Blood glucose monitors
(and related sales/testing supplies)
Infrared thermometers
Pulse oximeters
Nebulizers and homecare inhalers

Established in 1999
Shenzhen Kingyield Technology
operates primarily as an Original Brand Manufacturer (OBM) and direct factory producer specializing in digital homecare and clinical medical equipment, most notably blood pressure smartwatches, upper-arm and wrist monitors, and cloud-connected remote health tracking systems.
kingyield
Product Brands
Kingyield (KINGYIELD):
The core flagship brand utilized internationally for medical-grade monitors, digital sphygmomanometers, and FDA-cleared wearable blood pressure smartwatches.
kingyield
OEM/ODM White-Label Lines:
A large portion of their manufacturing output is supplied unbranded or customized for global medical device distributors, digital health platforms, and regional healthcare providers.
Manufacturer Partners & Business Relationships
Direct Production & Facilities:
Operates out of its primary development and assembly bases in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China (such as Fuhai industrial zones).
Market Growth Reports
Regulatory & Tech Ecosystem Partners:
Collaborates with compliance and testing bodies like DQS for ISO certifications, and partners with major telehealth infrastructure providers and remote patient monitoring (RPM) software networks to integrate its cloud-connected hardware. Specific joint manufacturing or tier-1 co-branding partnerships are largely kept under strict proprietary OEM/ODM contracts.
